declarations.ScreenshotNode:
export interface ScreenshotNode {
  id: string;
  layerName?: string; // Optional user-facing name in the layer stack
  path: string; // Relative layout path stored in DB (e.g., "mobile/1234-image.png")
  signedUrl?: string; // Added at runtime by RSC for rendering
  iosPath?: string; // Persisted — iOS screenshot path
  iosSignedUrl?: string; // Runtime-only
  androidPath?: string; // Persisted — Android screenshot path
  androidSignedUrl?: string; // Runtime-only
  position: Position;
  scale: number;
  rotation: number;
  zIndex: number;
  overflow?: boolean; // Allow device to overflow to adjacent screens
  tiltAngle?: number; // For tilted phone display (-30 to 30 degrees)
  phoneId?: string; // Phone ID from registry (e.g., 'iphone-17-pro-max', 'google-pixel')
  tabletId?: string; // Tablet ID from registry (e.g., 'ipad-pro-12.9')
  desktopId?: string; // Desktop ID from registry (e.g., 'macbook-pro-16')
  watchId?: string; // Watch ID from registry (e.g., 'apple-watch-41')
  variant3D?:
    | "left"
    | "left-2"
    | "right"
    | "right-2"
    | "handheld"
    | "handheld2"
    | "handheld3"
    | "flat"
    | "none"; // 3D rendering variant
  fitMode?: ScreenshotFitMode; // Screenshot mapping inside frame (default: stretch)
  showCamera?: boolean; // Whether to show the camera punch hole/notch (default: true)
  cleanStatusBar?: boolean; // Replace the baked-in status bar with a clean 9:41 marketing bar; skipped when the top strip isn't a uniform background. Unset means the platform default (on for iOS, off for Android - the bar is Apple's), so always read it through resolveCleanStatusBar()
  contentRotation?: 0 | 90 | 180 | 270; // Screenshot content rotation inside the frame, in degrees CW; undefined = auto (0 for portrait upload, 90 for landscape upload)
  contentTransform?: ScreenshotContentTransform; // Pan/zoom of the screenshot content inside the device screen; undefined = default fit
  windowTitle?: string; // macOS window title bar text (desktop "none" variant)
  opacity?: number; // Transparency 0-100 (default 100 = fully opaque)
  hidden?: boolean; // Hide in editor/export layer rendering
  locked?: boolean; // Prevent direct canvas interaction
  shadow?: ShadowConfig; // Drop shadow configuration
  model3D?: Model3DConfig; // Live Three.js glTF device (highest-priority device kind); overrides phone/tablet/desktop/watch frames
}
declarations.ScreenshotFitMode:
/**
 * How a screenshot maps onto the device screen.
 * - `stretch` distorts the image to fill the screen (no crop, wrong aspect)
 * - `cover` fills the screen at the correct aspect and crops the overflow
 * - `contain` fits the whole image at the correct aspect and fills the
 *   remainder with the colour of the image edge each bar touches
 *
 * The UI calls these Stretch / Crop / Fit. `cover` was labelled "Fit" until
 * Aug 2026, so layouts saved before then mean "crop to fill" by `cover`.
 */
export type ScreenshotFitMode = "stretch" | "cover" | "contain";
declarations.ThemeColors:
export interface ThemeColors {
  primary: string; // Dominant surface/background color
  secondary: string; // Supporting surface/background color
  accent: string; // Distinctive brand/action color; equals primary when none is observed
  background?: string; // Background color (defaults to primary if not set)
  text: string; // Primary text color
  textSecondary: string; // Secondary text color
  // Derived roles — computed deterministically from the five base roles by
  // deriveThemeRoles (themePalette.ts), never chosen by the model.
  panel?: string; // Adaptive block surface: accent when visibly distinct from primary, else the ink
  onPanel?: string; // Ink guaranteed readable on `panel`
  onAccent?: string; // Ink guaranteed readable on accent-colored surfaces
  tile?: string; // Adaptive card surface: secondary when visibly elevated above primary, else `panel`
  onTile?: string; // Ink guaranteed readable on `tile`
}
declarations.Screen:
// Screen interface - contains all elements for a single screen
export interface Screen {
  id: string;
  name?: string; // Optional user-facing artboard name
  index: number; // Display order (0-based)
  screenType: number; // Determines which render function to use (0-4, typically). Preserved on duplicate/reorder.
  screenshots: ScreenshotNode[]; // Screenshots/phones for this screen (supports multiple)
  texts: TextNode[]; // Text elements for this screen
  pills?: PillNode[]; // Pills for this screen
  badges?: BadgeNode[]; // Badges for this screen
  blobs?: BlobNode[]; // Blobs for this screen
  ratings?: RatingNode[]; // Ratings for this screen
  logo?: LogoNode; // Logo for this screen
  illustrations?: IllustrationNode[]; // Illustrations for this screen
  magnifiers?: MagnifierNode[]; // Magnifier overlays for this screen
  emojis?: EmojiNode[]; // Emoji elements for this screen
  backgroundColor?: string; // Per-screen background color (overrides template default)
  backgroundGradient?: Gradient; // Per-screen background gradient (overrides template default)
  colorRefs?: ColorRefs; // Optional links from background/gradient colors to theme roles
  backgroundImage?: {
    url: string;
    storagePath?: string; // Path in Supabase storage for deletion
    blur?: number; // Blur intensity 0-20 (default: 0 = no blur)
    verticalOffset?: number; // 0-100, where 50 is centered (default)
    horizontalOffset?: number; // 0-100, where 50 is centered (default)
    attribution?: PanoramaAttribution; // Reuse attribution type for Pexels images
  };
}

declarations.layoutSchema:
export const layoutSchema: z.ZodType<Layout> = z
  .object({
    template: z.string(),
    platform: appPlatformSchema,
    screens: z.array(screenSchema),
    headers: z.array(headerNodeSchema).optional(),
    canvasWidth: z.number().int().positive(),
    canvasHeight: z.number().int().positive(),
    backgroundColor: colorSchema,
    backgroundGradient: gradientSchema.optional(),
    colorRefs: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).optional(),
    panoramaBackground: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
    themeColors: z
      .object({
        primary: colorSchema,
        secondary: colorSchema,
        // Layouts saved before the accent requirement (pre Jul 2026 template
        // refactor) have no accent — accept them and fall back to primary,
        // instead of failing every save of a legacy project with a 500.
        accent: colorSchema.optional(),
        background: colorSchema.optional(),
        text: colorSchema,
        textSecondary: colorSchema,
      })
      .passthrough()
      .transform((themeColors) => ({
        ...themeColors,
        accent: themeColors.accent ?? themeColors.primary,
      }))
      .optional(),
    orientation: z.enum(["portrait", "landscape"]).optional(),
    layerGroups: z.array(z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())).optional(),
  })
  .passthrough() as z.ZodType<Layout>;

declarations.MultiPhoneContentSchema:
const MultiPhoneContentSchema = z.object({
  // Preserve the authored arrangement when adding slots; explicit layout picks reset it.
  layoutDeviceCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(6).nullable().optional(),
  devicePresentations: z
    .array(DevicePresentationSchema.nullable())
    .max(6)
    .nullable()
    .optional(),
  mediaRotations: z
    .array(MediaRotationSchema.nullable())
    .max(6)
    .nullable()
    .optional(),
  deviceModels: z
    .array(z.enum(DEVICE_MODEL_IDS).nullable())
    .max(6)
    .nullable()
    .optional(),
  screenshotIndexes: z.array(z.number().int().min(0)).min(1).max(6),
  layout: z.enum(["cascade", "fan", "side-by-side", "custom"]),
  title: z.string().nullable(),
  titleStyle: TextStyleSchema.nullable().optional(),
  // Per-element `.catch("flat")` self-heals legacy/sparse arrays: editing a
  // non-zero phone index used to persist holes (e.g. [null, null, "left"]),
  // which JSON-serialize to null and would otherwise reject the ENTIRE config
  // and drop the user into the onboarding tutorial. Coerce bad entries instead.
  frameVariants: z
    .array(z.enum(["flat", "left", "right"]).catch("flat"))
    .max(6)
    .nullable()
    .optional(),
  /**
   * Per-phone video clips, by phone index. A slot holding a clip renders it in
   * the frame instead of its screenshot, so a multi-phone scene can mix stills
   * and recordings. Sparse like the arrays above: index alignment is what maps
   * a clip to a phone.
   */
  videos: z.array(SceneVideoSchema.nullable()).max(6).nullable().optional(),
  /** Per-phone manual position overrides (from dragging), by phone index. */
  phonePositions: z
    .array(PhonePositionSchema.nullable())
    .max(6)
    .nullable()
    .optional(),
  phoneScales: z
    .array(
      z
        .number()
        .min(0.4)
        .max(2.5)
        .nullable()
        .transform((value) => value ?? 1),
    )
    .max(6)
    .nullable()
    .optional(),
  phoneRotations: z
    .array(
      z
        .number()
        .min(-90)
        .max(90)
        .nullable()
        .transform((value) => value ?? 0),
    )
    .max(6)
    .nullable()
    .optional(),
  textAnimation: TextAnimationSchema,
});

declarations.projectMediaPathSchema:
export const projectMediaPathSchema = z
  .string()
  .min(1)
  .max(1024)
  .refine(
    (path) =>
      !path.startsWith("/") &&
      !path.includes("\\") &&
      !path.includes("\0") &&
      path
        .split("/")
        .every(
          (segment) => segment !== "" && segment !== "." && segment !== "..",
        ),
    { message: "Media path must be project-relative" },
  );
declarations.legacyStateSchema:
const legacyStateSchema = z.object({
  selectedMediaPath: projectMediaPathSchema.nullable(),
  deviceModelId: z.enum(DEVICE_MODEL_IDS).default("iphone-17-pro"),
  motion: z.enum([
    "hero-reveal",
    "feature-sweep",
    "showcase-orbit",
    "parallax-tilt",
    "custom",
  ]),
  finish: z.enum([
    "silver",
    "cosmic-orange",
    "deep-blue",
    "pixel-obsidian",
    "pixel-porcelain",
    "pixel-moonstone",
  ]),
  speed: z.number().min(0.7).max(1.4),
  background: z.enum(["soft", "paper", "midnight", "transparent"]),
  backgroundMode: z.enum(["color", "gradient", "image"]).default("color"),
  backgroundColor: z.string(),
  backgroundGradient: z
    .object({
      from: z.string(),
      to: z.string(),
      angle: z.number(),
    })
    .nullable()
    .default(null),
  backgroundImage: z
    .object({
      url: z.string(),
      storagePath: projectMediaPathSchema.optional(),
      blur: z.number().min(0).max(20).optional(),
      verticalOffset: z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(),
      horizontalOffset: z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(),
      attribution: z
        .object({
          source: z.enum(["pexels", "unsplash"]),
          photographer: z.string(),
          photographerUrl: z.string(),
          pexelsUrl: z.string().optional(),
          unsplashUrl: z.string().optional(),
        })
        .optional(),
    })
    .nullable()
    .default(null),
  showDynamicIsland: z.boolean().default(false),
  // Legacy: lid openness lives on the keyframes now. Older saved states still
  // carry it and are migrated on load, so it stays accepted but optional.
  lidOpen: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
  outputRatio: z.enum(["1:1", "4:3", "16:9", "9:16"]),
  motionDuration: z.number().min(1).max(60),
  deviceScale: z.number().min(0.7).max(1.3),
  primaryKeyframes: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        id: z.string().min(1),
        time: z.number().min(0).max(1),
        x: z.number().min(-3).max(3),
        y: z.number().min(-3).max(3),
        rotationX: z
          .number()
          .min(-2 * Math.PI)
          .max(2 * Math.PI),
        rotationY: z
          .number()
          .min(-2 * Math.PI)
          .max(2 * Math.PI),
        rotationZ: z
          .number()
          .min(-2 * Math.PI)
          .max(2 * Math.PI),
        scale: z.number().min(0.2).max(3),
        lidOpen: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
        easing: z.enum(["linear", "ease-in", "ease-out", "ease-in-out"]),
      }),
    )
    .min(2)
    .max(8),
  isPlaying: z.boolean(),
  overlay: z
    .object({
      enabled: z.boolean(),
      mediaPath: projectMediaPathSchema.nullable(),
      shape: z.enum(["circle", "rectangle"]),
      x: z.number().min(0).max(1),
      y: z.number().min(0).max(1),
      size: z.number().min(0).max(1),
      mirrored: z.boolean(),
      audioVolume: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
    })
    .nullable()
    .default(null),
  audio: MockupAudioTrackSchema.nullable().default(null),
});

    candidateId: promoCandidateSelectionSchema.shape.candidateId.optional(),
    config: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),

 * Default pose applied when a 3D-model device is added or a node is switched
 * to 3D: square to the canvas, matching the "Front" preset.
 *
 * A device that arrives pre-turned reads as a choice the user did not make,
 * and the pose grid then highlights nothing because a three-quarter default
 * matches no preset exactly. Starting at Front makes the selected preset and
 * the canvas agree, and every other pose one click away.
 */

  rotationX: 0,
  rotationY: 0,
  rotationZ: 0,
};
